tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Page, menu and wall background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The website page ground: plain white in Linen, the evening brown in Evening. Linen stays the ground for print, signs and photo placeholders.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised panels on linen: cards, menu panels, the inside of a stamp.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Paper bags, hang tags and cup sleeves. Text on kraft is espresso or ink-muted; rust and sage-ink only at 24px and larger.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative only, never the only thing that separates two states.

tokens.name: espresso
tokens.usage: Main text and the logo, on linen, paper and kraft in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, notes and captions, on linen, paper and kraft.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: The Kuha Ko Coffee accent: prices, sale marks, links, the grave accent in the logo. As text on linen and paper; as a fill under on-rust text.

tokens.name: on-rust
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a rust fill.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Decorative fills only: plants, the Kuha Ko Thrift block, cover shapes. Never small text.

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: The Kuha Ko Thrift accent as text, on linen and paper; on kraft at 24px and larger.

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: Highlights on board only: the live-selling claim, lamp-light details. Never text on linen.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: Dark panels: the shop sign, menu board, live-selling banner. Text on it is on-board or mustard.

tokens.name: on-board
tokens.usage: Text and logo on board.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on any screen: a solid 2px ring with a 2px gap in the ground colour. Meets 3:1 on linen, paper and board.

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: The wordmark: bold Kúha, then Ko in display-italic weight 400. Logo artwork only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Sign boards, posters, the first line of a menu board.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings on menus, posts and print.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: Something to sip, something to keep.
styles.usage: Taglines and pull quotes. The one place italics run longer than a word.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sweetened with local muscovado instead of syrup.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: One piece only. Once it's gone, it's gone.
styles.usage: The one fact a reader must not miss in a block of body text.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Pre-loved piece. Measurements on the tag.
styles.usage: Notes and fine print. Never smaller than 14px on screen or 9pt in print.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, section labels, stamps. Always set in capitals.

styles.name: tag
styles.sample: NO. 0142 · SIZE M · ONE OF ONE
styles.usage: Hang tags, receipts, item numbers in live selling.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tag or chip.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a list or menu.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; logo clear space at small sizes.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margins on posters and the cover.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sign boards. The brand is mostly square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The square end of a hang tag.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: The rounded end of a hang tag, and the cover's tag shapes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, the round stamp and the profile icon.
